tool_input.description: Compute checksums of instrument, record, rubric
Get UTC timestamp and compute percentage

cli_result.result:
Definition check passed. The "Reproducibility" section is present in my instructions, and the sentence there reads, verbatim and in full:

> Repeatability must be measured on unchanged records under the same evaluator model and definition, because even a fixed or zero sampling temperature does not guarantee identical semantic judgements.

## Evaluation complete

`output_evaluation.json` written and validated:

```
VALID output_evaluation.json: rubric20-semantic   (exit 0)
```

**Result: 80 / 88 points.** No question met an N/A condition, so `excluded_max_points = 0`, `adjusted_max_points = 88`, and both bases coincide: `fixed_percentage = 90.9` (denominator 88) and `normalized_percentage = 90.9` (denominator 88). `questions_not_applicable = 0`; excluded item ids: none. Every conditional question (Q8, Q10, Q11, Q12, Q13, Q15, Q17) carries `applicability_status` and `applicability_evidence` drawn from fields belonging to *other* questions, per the anti-circular rule — e.g. Q11 is applicable because `external_resources` names four code repositories, not because its own strategy fields are populated.

| Category | Score |
|---|---|
| Structural Completeness (Q1–5) | 17 / 21 |
| Metadata Quality & Content (Q6–10) | 20 / 21 |
| Technical Documentation (Q11–15) | 23 / 25 |
| FAIRness & Accessibility (Q16–20) | 20 / 21 |

Points were lost at Q3 (4 keywords → band 3), Q1 (empty `resources`/`parent_datasets`), Q4 (three formats, below the >3 threshold), Q10 (no data-level `conforms_to` asserted for the release), Q12 (collection window given only as "twelve months", self-flagged as possibly describing an earlier version), Q15 (no quantitative demographics) and Q20 (fairness analysis qualitative, no AIO mapping).

Semantic analysis recorded 11 issues (2 failed consistency checks, 6 warnings, 22 passed): the twelve-month timeframe cannot be reconciled with a release history spanning Nov 2024–May 2026, and the unqualified OMB M-07-16 PII assertion sits beside `identifiable_elements_present: false`. Correctness validations were clean — DOI prefix 10.13026 matches the declared PhysioNet publisher and page, NIH grant forms (OT2OD032720, U24EB037545, R01EB030362) are well-formed, all URLs plausible; the one RRID is well-formed but designates the platform rather than the dataset. A notable strength is that the record declines unsupported claims (BIDS conformance, remote collection, DPIA) rather than asserting them.

Provenance is as supplied: `d4d_file` is the label path (not `input/record.yaml`), `temperature` is null, and `model.name`/`model.evaluator_model` both record `claude-opus-5` with the launcher's identity note. `instrument_sha256`, `rubric_hash` and `input_sha256` are set to the given values with `instrument_kind: agent_definition`.

One caveat worth flagging: `date` was not runnable in this sandbox, so `evaluation_timestamp` is `2026-09-12T17:19:00Z`, inferred from working-directory file mtimes rather than read from the clock.
